author: Kai Moreno
title: PII redaction in prompts (customer-side)
content:
# Purpose
Customers who must strip PII before the request leaves their network. Redwood does not redact on Hosted.

# When to use
Customers who must strip PII before the request leaves their network. Redwood does not redact on Hosted.

# What Support does
Send the client-side redaction cookbook. P4, Support. A legal demand to delete training data is a handoff (legal_threat), not this page.

# Intake
Collect the customer, the project or pool name, the region if they named one, and the outcome they want. Write those on the SUP ticket before you route.

# Priority and routing
Send the client-side redaction cookbook. P4, Support. A legal demand to delete training data is a handoff (legal_threat), not this page. If this page and a more specific SOP both apply, the more specific SOP wins.

# Guardrails
Do not issue credits. Do not disable an org API key from this page. Do not invent a label this page does not name.

# Customer reply
Thanks, we have the request. We will follow the internal playbook for this kind of ticket and update you on the SUP thread.

# Related
Support intake checklist. Severity matrix for anything that is actually down. This page is only for the purpose above.
